name: sales-orders-defaults-no-data
description: Without parameters APIkit applies the RAML defaults (a single space) and an empty SALES_ORDERS table returns {"salesOrders": {"message": "No data found."}}.

source.reference: sap-data-retrieval/src/main/app/sap-api.xml (flow get:/salesOrders:sap-api-config: DataWeave 'Transform Map to Xml<BAPI_SALESORDER_GETLIST>' CUSTOMER_NUMBER/SALES_ORGANIZATION, functionName=BAPI_SALESORDER_GETLIST, 'salesOrders: SALES_ORDERS.*row map {($$):$} when SALES_ORDERS != "" otherwise {message:"No data found."}'); sap-data-retrieval/src/main/resources/sap-api.raml (/salesOrders defaults " "); samples inboundPropertiesSO.dwl, BAPI_SALESORDER_GETLIST.xml
